title: Read the environment checks
description: You identify the environment recorded for the genetic algorithm notebook.

steps.description: You import the listed modules and print the first whitespace-separated part of sys.version. The recorded version is 3.12.16.
You print platform.platform() to identify the operating environment. The recorded platform string begins with Linux.

steps.question: What determines the value printed after In Colab?
steps.answer: Membership of google.colab in sys.modules determines it. The recorded value is False.

steps.description: You finish with three environment fields in the output. The two installation suggestions are comments.
